title: Week arrows do nothing; no week has any games
what_happened: On my phone I pressed the next-week arrow beside the dash. Nothing changed: still a dash for the week and No NFL games scheduled yet. I have nothing to show my friends about what they would be picking.
expected: The arrows move between weeks and show each week's games

title: Ran away before finishing: Reached the sign-in wall on the phone: Email and Password or Google, with a Sign Up tab. The box fits the phone. Still no sign that a private group for friends is possible, and no games on any week to show the group.
what_happened: The Walker left at step 5 without reaching the goal: Reached the sign-in wall on the phone: Email and Password or Google, with a Sign Up tab. The box fits the phone. Still no sign that a private group for friends is possible, and no games on any week to show the group.
expected: The Walker can finish the journey's goal
